rules.description: SYN connection attempt to the broker.
Complete HELLO/AUTH command lines in the request direction after TCP reassembly and retransmission removal.
Complete SUBSCRIBE/SUB command lines in the request direction after TCP reassembly and retransmission removal.
Complete PUBLISH/PUB command lines in the request direction after TCP reassembly and retransmission removal.
Complete DELIVER/MSG command lines in the response direction after TCP reassembly and retransmission removal.

manual_checks: The supplied command counter uses LF/CRLF framing. If E1 selects JSON or binary framing, supply and test the corresponding decoder in the student validator; do not replace logical counts with frame counts.
Correlate client identities, topics/keys and request IDs with pytest assertions to prove the required application behaviour.
R1 R2 R3: Decode LF/CRLF command lines or supply the E1 framing decoder; correlate client and topic.
R4 R5: Assert payloads and recipients, then verify unsubscribe and the E1 duplicate/delivery policy.
